title: Funky Head Boxers
native_title: ファンキー・ヘッド・ボクサーズ
overview:
The second entry in the Yoshimoto Funky series! Yoshimoto remakes a Sega arcade game!!

Advanced action & comedy perfected by the tag team of Sega and Yoshimoto
Super-extreme fun that goes beyond the arcade version
3D polygons show their true power with the Boyoyon System!?
Yoshimoto's young comedians unleash their all-out, reckless power

A lineup of goofy faces that will make even the ring trip up. Look forward to an all-out brawl!

Funky Head Boxers is a comedy boxing game built on Sega's arcade original, with Yoshimoto comedians stepping into the ring. Every fighter has a giant cube-shaped head that squashes and warps under each blow. Trade jabs and hooks, land special punches with joystick commands and go for the knockout. Alone, pick a boxer, build up their abilities with training and take on one opponent after another, or face a friend head to head.

- Training between bouts and two-player versus
- 1 or 2 players
- Memory backup save

吉本ファンキーシリーズ第二弾！セガのアーケードゲームを吉本がリメイク！！

セガと吉本のタッグが極めた高度なアクション＆お笑い
アーケード版の上をゆく超ド級のおもしろさ
ボヨヨンシステムで3Dポリゴンの本領発揮！？
吉本若手芸人の捨て身のパワー炸裂

リングもコケる、へなちょこ顔合わせ。大混戦に乞うご期待！
